mapper.insert: INSERT INTO company_safety_profile (company_id, industry_code, sub_industry, employee_count, primary_process, hazard_factors, risk_score, risk_grade) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{industryCode}, #{subIndustry}, #{employeeCount}, #{primaryProcess}, COALESCE(#{hazardFactors}, '[]')::jsonb, #{riskScore}, #{riskGrade})
mapper.update: UPDATE company_safety_profile SET industry_code = COALESCE(#{industryCode}, industry_code), sub_industry = COALESCE(#{subIndustry}, sub_industry), employee_count = COALESCE(#{employeeCount}, employee_count), primary_process = COALESCE(#{primaryProcess}, primary_process), hazard_factors = COALESCE(#{hazardFactors}::jsonb, hazard_factors), risk_score = COALESCE(#{riskScore}, risk_score), risk_grade = COALESCE(#{riskGrade}, risk_grade), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
